aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:849.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Job Summary The Access Control position will maintain the safety of all employees, guests and clients at Deluxx Fluxx events within Webster Hall through constant patrol, observation and documentation. This position will be first point of contact for all security related issues and will control the diffusion of incidents at the event. The Security Officer will also assist with customer service requests. Essential Functions Monitor assigned area of venue on foot. Observe, report, and control ongoing activity keeping track of unusual occurrences. Assist with the ejection or control of unruly, disruptive, intoxicated guests. Monitor entry and access point for the venue. Ensure all guests and employees have appropriate access to be in each specific area. Escort artists, VIPs, guests and employees to protect and prevent unwanted attention, disruption, incident or injury. Respond immediately to fire control center to locate, acknowledge and silence alarm. Check signal area, report and reset alarm. Enact fire safety/evacuations when necessary. Respond, observe and document all medical situations and request EMT/medical personnel. Assist with minor first aid situations. Coordinate transportation for friends and family of afflicted when necessary. Assist with all customer service needs before, during and after each show, including: directions, instructions, information, escorts and medical. Screen and confirm all employees, vendors, delivery personnel, guests and artists entering venue to ensure appropriate access. Review and verity documentation to ensure validity. Log all activity, movement and repairs in appropriate log ensuring all incidents are accurately documented. Required Qualifications A minimum education level of: High School Diploma or its equivalency 1 – 2 years of related work experience Strong interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills. Expert organizational, leadership and time management skills. Ability to qualify and be issued a security officer license. Ability to obtain and maintain a Guard Card CPR and AED certification Knowledge of rules and regulations with good understanding of right and wrong Must be able to stand for long periods of time Must be able to work long hours including nights, weekends and some holidays Knowledge of music industry and live events preferred Payscale: $36.05 Bonus: This position is Not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. Benefits: Part-time: This position may be eligible for benefits (ACA qualification). jobgether-jobgether:lever:6838aa0c-7bb2-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Algotale - SCOM Consultant (Delphi) based in India. This role is an opportunity for an experienced systems monitoring professional to design, implement, and optimize enterprise-scale Microsoft SCOM environments. You will take ownership of monitoring architecture, operational reliability, management packs, automation, and performance across complex IT infrastructures. The position involves supporting technologies including Windows Server, Linux, VMware, SQL Server, Active Directory, Azure, and business-critical applications. You will help organizations strengthen proactive monitoring, improve infrastructure visibility, and maintain high availability across thousands of monitored devices. The role combines hands-on technical delivery with troubleshooting, automation, documentation, and stakeholder engagement. You will work independently while contributing to enterprise monitoring strategies, ITSM integrations, and continuous operational improvement. This is a strong fit for a technically skilled SCOM specialist who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges and working in a remote environment. Design, architect, deploy, and administer Microsoft System Center Operations Manager (SCOM) solutions for enterprise environments. Lead end-to-end SCOM implementations, including planning, installation, configuration, migration, upgrades, and ongoing administration. Configure and manage Management Groups, Management Servers, Gateways, Web Console, Reporting, and Data Warehouse components. Develop monitoring strategies aligned with business, infrastructure, and operational requirements. Implement proactive monitoring for Windows Server, Linux, VMware, SQL Server, Exchange, Active Directory, Azure, and business-critical applications. Configure alerts, notifications, dashboards, distributed applications, and service-level monitoring to improve infrastructure visibility. Deploy, configure, maintain, and customize Microsoft and third-party Management Packs, including monitors, rules, discoveries, views, dashboards, and reports. Develop custom monitoring solutions using PowerShell, WMI, SNMP, and scripting technologies. Monitor SCOM health and performance, identify infrastructure optimization opportunities, and contribute to capacity planning. Troubleshoot and resolve SCOM infrastructure issues, agent failures, alert storms, monitoring gaps, and other operational incidents. Manage SCOM agents throughout their lifecycle, including deployment, upgrades, maintenance, and troubleshooting. Perform SCOM patching, health checks, upgrades, performance tuning, and preventive maintenance. Develop custom reports and dashboards using SCOM Reporting and Power BI integrations. Automate operational activities using PowerShell and System Center components to improve efficiency and reliability. Integrate SCOM with ticketing and ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow. Prepare technical documentation, operational runbooks, and knowledge-transfer materials while supporting customer-facing engagements. Requirements: 5+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft SCOM , with proven experience supporting enterprise-scale monitoring environments. Demonstrated experience with end-to-end SCOM architecture, implementation, migration, administration, troubleshooting, and operational support. Strong expertise with SCOM 2016, 2019, and/or 2022 . Solid experience designing and customizing Management Packs, including monitors, rules, discoveries, views, dashboards, and reports. Strong knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, IIS, SQL Server, and Azure services. Practical experience monitoring Linux/Unix systems through SCOM. Strong PowerShell scripting and automation capabilities. Experience with SCOM reporting, dashboards, performance tuning, and enterprise monitoring best practices. jobgether-jobgether:lever:6c621279-1efc-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Support Engineer based in France. As a Technical Support Engineer, you will be a key technical resource for enterprise customers across the EMEA region, helping them resolve complex issues and get maximum value from a sophisticated ecommerce technology platform. You will own customer-facing support conversations across tickets, Slack, and calls, guiding customers from initial investigation through resolution. The role combines hands-on troubleshooting with exceptional communication, customer enablement, and continuous improvement of support operations. You will work extensively with APIs, SDKs, logs, event data, integrations, tagging, and implementation behavior to diagnose technical challenges. As an early member of a newly established support function, you will have significant influence over processes, documentation, automation, escalation paths, and team practices. You will partner closely with customers as well as Customer Success, Solutions, Product, Engineering, and other internal teams to resolve issues and share valuable product feedback. This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong, customer-obsessed problem solver who wants to build scalable support practices while working with cutting-edge ecommerce and AI technology. Own customer-facing technical support cases across tickets, Slack, and calls, ensuring customers understand what is known, what is being investigated, and what happens next. Build trust with technical and business stakeholders through clear communication, effective expectation management, and actionable explanations of complex technical issues. Troubleshoot issues by reviewing API behavior, payloads, logs, configurations, implementation details, HTTP requests, and other relevant technical information. Investigate and resolve blockers related to data ingestion, tagging, event instrumentation, API performance, and implementation, particularly when they affect launches, customer confidence, or ongoing platform usage. Coordinate escalations with Product, Engineering, Solutions, Customer Success, and other internal teams, providing clear context including business impact, reproduction steps, examples, urgency, and customer-facing implications. Serve as a technical subject-matter expert, helping customers understand expected platform behavior, integration approaches, troubleshooting techniques, and implementation options. Review and improve self-service support and automated responses, identify gaps, and help refine escalation criteria. Create and maintain knowledge-base content, troubleshooting guides, technical documentation, macros, internal notes, and reusable support resources. Identify recurring customer questions, technical issues, and support pain points, turning those insights into actionable feedback for Product and Engineering teams. Support customers across EMEA business hours with strong ownership, responsiveness, and consistently high-quality written and verbal communication. Continuously improve support processes, playbooks, workflows, and escalation paths to increase efficiency, consistency, and customer satisfaction. As an early member of the support team, contribute to establishing scalable foundations and practices that can support the growth of the function. Requirements: 4+ years of experience in technical support, technical account management, solutions engineering, implementation, customer-facing engineering, or a comparable technical customer role.
